limits: Synthetic sources in temporary directories: the SPEC-023 generic trace fixture and episodes built by system_one_shadow.build_episode; no real host transcript or System One store is read. Recorded traces and episodes are content-free by contract, so host-transcript records carry tools and statuses, not prompts. The full System One isolation test is procedure_007 (T009). Loom carries no model text or reward, which the loss notes state. Refused content stubs carry no attempt, so content-refused is a run-level note. Redaction limits are those of procedure_003 and procedure_004.
outcome: passed: T007: lightning_adapter turns one attempt's SPEC-070 events plus its redacted content records into braid-lightning-triplet/v0.1 records, one per model_request, and braid-lightning-messages/v0.1 user and assistant turns; the committed Loom corpus becomes one triplet per strand and one system message per event. Every text is redacted with the run salt and post-scanned (redaction classes counted), and each record carries source, sourceSha256 and sorted loss notes. Rewards match by first-occurrence (nearest earlier unrewarded request) or first-sibling (others refused with reward-match); a second content record for one request is ignored with content-duplicate. Outputs are deterministic for the same inputs and salt. Without consent, or for an unlisted source, prompt, response and messages are null or empty with content-consent-required while rewards stay. An unparseable Loom stream or an unknown attempt is refused with source-invalid. Negative control: with redaction switched off a canary in a Loom label reaches the output and the clean check fails. T008: a recorded host transcript (trace_adapter.read_trace and import_trace) becomes one triplet per host turn with its tool as the tool call and prompt-missing, model-text-unavailable and reward-unavailable notes, and one system message per turn; a System One day file (opened read-only, each line through system_one_shadow.validate_episode) becomes one triplet per episode (System 2 pairs as prompt, System One answer as response, reward-unavailable) and user and assistant messages. Both are redacted (an email canary in a tool name is removed), consent-gated per source and refused with source-invalid when they do not validate; the episode file's bytes, mtime and directory listing are unchanged after reading.
